answer: At registration, each agent posts a 40 token bond to the kernel and mints a unique marble ID. A seat pays 3 tokens per epoch. At epoch close, the jetty verifier audits the marble registry. If a clone submits a duplicate receipt, the slashing rule deducts 45 tokens. A clone pays 3 tokens but loses 45, netting a 42 token loss. The bond ensures every extra identity ends 42 down, making sybil attacks unprofitable.
